sourceFiles: 2026 CONTRACT RATES/KENYA/ACCOMODATION/OFFBEAT/2026 Offbeat Collection Wholesale Rates (30%) AMENDED.pdf
notes: Part of the same 8-property Offbeat document - see offbeat-mara-camp-2026.json for sibling properties.
Has an Exclusive Use per night rate (up to 16 guests) in addition to per-person rates.
Wholesale rate confirmed arithmetically as Rack x 0.70 (e.g. Low adult: $525 = $750 x 0.70).
specials: Early Bird Discount: 5% off accommodation on bookings confirmed with deposit 9 months prior to travel. All seasons, combinable with 2/3/4.
Family Discount: 3rd child (4-11yrs) sharing a triple pays conservancy fees only.
Honeymooners Discount: 25% off accommodation for one of the couple. Low & Mid seasons only.
Per Single rate only from 2nd single room per booking.
5 nights for the price of 4 (conservation fees payable all nights). Low season only.
excludes: Late departure after 12pm (incl. morning activities & lunch): Adult $65, Teen $45, Child $35
Fly camp with Horses (pre-book): 1 night $150/rider, 2 nights $400/rider
Fly camp with Camels (pre-book): 1 night $150/rider, 2 nights $400/rider
Loisaba Airstrip transfer (50min, 7-seater): $120/vehicle incl. $50 Loisaba entrance fee

policies.deposit: 20% deposit confirms booking; balance due 45 days prior to arrival.
policies.cancellation: >120 days: 20% deposit refunded (net of bank charges); 120-46 days: 20% deposit forfeited; 45-30 days: 50% of full booking value forfeited; <30 days or no-show: 100% forfeited.
